reason: Run 01 used Python text-mode shard reads, normalizing CRLF to LF; this violated the preregistered raw-line-byte split key and canonical byte reconstruction. Run 01 is excluded from qualification evidence.
contamination_caveat: Run-01 aggregate test metrics were observed before this amendment. Therefore Run-02 test results are replication/post-inspection evidence, not pristine confirmatory evidence.
parser: binary shard reads; concatenate exact bytes; splitlines(keepends=True); JSON decode each raw line

split.key: SHA256(exact raw canonical JSONL line bytes including original line terminator)

models.B1: train P(error|surface); choose threshold from [0.1,0.2,...,0.9] by maximum DEV detection F1 only; tie -> higher threshold; correction = most frequent TRAIN gold alternative, Unicode tie-break

qualification_rule: May establish external empirical evidence for spelling stratum with contamination caveat; MUST NOT be labeled pristine confirmatory or generalized to full ErrorFamily/open-domain.
